_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Financial Estimated Network Activity (NWA) Accrual Report
summary: The Financial Estimated Network Activity (NWA) Accrual Report provides the Government with an estimate of contractor labor costs and Other Direct Cost (ODC) expenses for each project task.
use_relationship:
The Financial Estimated Network Activity (NWA) Accrual Report provides the Government with an estimate of contractor labor costs and Other Direct Cost (ODC) expenses for each project task. The report will be used to track accruals across multiple department's requisitions and Network Activities. It will be used to estimate burn rates and predict the number of weeks remaining before funds are depleted.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as specified in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Financial Estimated NWA report shall be in the government format provided in Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the information specified in Sample Figure 1 to enable financial tracking by Purchase Requisition number and Network Activity (NWA) for each project task. The Labor Total Balance divided by the Full Time Equivalent (FTE) Summary Burn Rate is used to calculate the estimated weeks to live.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The Media requirement for this electronic report shall be Microsoft Excel, version 2016.
